name: First sign-in completes the BidWatch introduction before the workspace
covers: technical SEO metadata and private-route indexing controls
self-referencing canonical and Open Graph metadata
description: Verifies a provisioned user receives a concise first-use introduction, can complete it, and can then use the normal bid workflow.
steps: Open the BidWatch sign-in screen and verify the page title, description, canonical, Open Graph image and noindex metadata
Sign in with the provisioned Google account for a user who has not completed onboarding
Verify the authenticated Dashboard remains noindex and has a self-referencing canonical plus Open Graph metadata
Review the three-step BidWatch introduction
Choose Start using BidWatch on the final step
Open Add bid and create a valid bid titled "Network Security RFP"
Refresh BidWatch
expected: The onboarding dialog is shown only before completion, the user reaches the Dashboard, the bid persists, and the introduction does not reappear after refresh.

name: Find and review ICT procurement opportunities from public sources
description: Verifies the new discovery workspace scans configured procurement sources, surfaces relevant opportunities, identifies inaccessible authenticated sources honestly, and lets an authorized user import a valid opportunity.
steps: Open Find Opportunities
Choose Scan sources
Review the PPPC and PPDA source statuses and any relevant ICT or cybersecurity opportunities
Verify MANEPS is reported through its public OCDS/API discovery path without asking for a MANEPS password
Filter opportunities to cybersecurity and sort them by priority and deadline urgency
Open a returned opportunity and review its source, organisation, reference, deadline, verification status, participation details and available documents
Verify expired opportunities are absent from the default current list and use Needs verification to inspect records without a published deadline
Change the rows-per-page control and move between Page 1 of N and later pages
Review an opportunity with a repeated reference and verify it identifies the other source instead of presenting the records as unrelated
If a deadline is missing, choose Verify source details and review the result
Prepare an import and verify the source fields are pre-filled for editing before adding it to BidWatch
Open All Bids
expected: Public-source results are shown inside BidWatch, MANEPS is not falsely represented as accessible when authentication is required, and an imported opportunity appears in All Bids without duplicating an existing reference or source URL.

name: Bid filters are explicitly labelled and remain usable on mobile
description: Verifies the two bid filters identify what they filter instead of presenting ambiguous repeated All controls, while remaining readable at a narrow viewport.
steps: Open All Bids at 375x667
Verify one filter is labelled Status and the other is labelled Category
Open the Status filter and select Reviewing
Verify only bids in the Reviewing stage remain
Open the Category filter and select Cybersecurity
Verify the result list reflects both selected filters
Increase browser text size or zoom and review the filter controls
expected: The filters have clear labels, their selections work together, and their labels and controls remain readable without clipping or ambiguous duplicate labels.

name: Destructive deletion preserves a text-only bid history record
description: Verifies an irreversible bid deletion requires explicit confirmation and preserves the bid metadata after stored documents are removed.
setup: Create a bid titled "Historical RFP" with organisation "Example Org" and a small PDF attachment
steps: Open the bid
Choose Delete bid and documents
Review the impact message and choose Keep it
Choose Delete bid and documents again
Choose Delete bid in the confirmation dialog
Open Bid History
expected: The bid disappears from active bids, its stored document is removed, and a text-only history record remains with the bid title, organisation, deadline, status and deletion date.

name: Concurrent bid changes and privileged administration remain protected
description: Verifies two users cannot silently overwrite a newer bid revision and privileged administrative operations remain server-enforced and explicitly confirmed.
steps: Actor A and Actor B open the same editable bid before either saves changes
Actor A saves a status or assignment change
Actor B attempts to save the stale version of that bid
Sign in as a role without bids.apply or bids.decline and attempt a protected status transition
Sign in as a non-Super-Admin role manager and attempt to allocate a sensitive access-control permission
Open a removable custom role and choose Delete role
Review the confirmation dialog and choose Keep it
expected: Actor B receives a stale-record conflict instead of overwriting Actor A's change, protected workflow transitions and sensitive permissions are rejected by the backend, and cancelling role deletion leaves the role intact.
